angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 994,851 km at 109.16 pc = 0.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.1607 +/- 0.0152 mas (same row, RUWE 1.06): 109.16 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.43 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Nicholson et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 152843 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.532.4632N/abstract): 994,851 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.15 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Nicholson et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 152843 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.532.4632N/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6310 +/- 100 K from Nicholson et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 152843 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.532.4632N/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Nicholson et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 152843 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.532.4632N/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-152843.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.188, rounded to two decimals

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
